international.title: USDA, FBI breached by hackers amid spate of tech outages – reports
international.summary: Latest intrusions targeted farmer-payment system at the USDA and the FBI’s National Crime Information Center Hackers breached the US Department of Agriculture (USDA) and the FBI , national media reported on Friday, amid deepening concerns over a spate of tech outages at key American institutions. The breaches were first reported by NBC News and CNN respectively, and it remained unclear whether they were related and who was responsible. Continue reading...
